title: Data and R code for: Oxygen isotopes in phosphate (δ18OP) reveal functional separation between labile and stable legacy phosphorus in soil
description:
Data and R code for the article Oxygen isotopes in phosphate (δ18OP) reveal functional separation between labile and stable legacy phosphorus in soil by Arfania, Kayler, Strawn, Brooks, Feber and Laan (Biogeochemistry).

The archive contains the oxygen isotope composition of phosphate (δ18OP) and the phosphorus concentration of four sequentially extracted (Hedley) fractions in 12 composite soil samples from the R. J. Cook Agronomy Farm (Pullman, Washington, USA), sampled at top-slope and toe-slope positions under conventional tillage and no-till on three winter dates, together with the soil-water δ18O and soil temperature used to calculate isotopic equilibrium.

The R scripts calculate the equilibrium values and the departure from equilibrium of every observation and reproduce Tables 1 and 2, Supplementary Tables S1 and S3, the statistics quoted in Sections 3.1 to 3.5 and Figure 3 of the article. Running run_all.R also writes a table that compares each quoted value with the script output.
